name: Summon Elemental

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

components.m: air, a pebble, ash and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP

upcast.text: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the Elemental Spirit stat block.

summary: Summon an Elemental Spirit (Air, Earth, Fire or Water) that fights beside you for up to 1 hour.
text: You call forth an elemental spirit, which appears in an unoccupied space within range and uses the Elemental Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Air, Earth, Fire or Water; the spirit is a bipedal shape wrapped in that element, and the choice sets some of its traits. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. It is an ally of you and your allies. In combat it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn right after yours. It follows your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you give none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to stay out of danger. Elemental Spirit (Medium Elemental): AC 11 + the spell's level; Hit Points 50 + 10 for each spell level above 4; Speed 40 ft., plus Burrow 40 ft. (Earth), Fly 40 ft. with hover (Air) or Swim 40 ft. (Water); Str 18, Dex 15, Con 17, Int 4, Wis 10, Cha 16; Resistances: Acid (Water), Lightning and Thunder (Air), Piercing and Slashing (Earth); Immunities: Poison damage, Fire damage (Fire only), and the Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned conditions; Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10; speaks Primordial and understands the languages you know; uses your Proficiency Bonus. Amorphous Form (Air, Fire and Water only): it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without that counting as Difficult Terrain. Multiattack: it makes a number of Slam attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down). Slam: melee attack using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; hit: 1d10 + 4 + the spell's level Bludgeoning (Earth), Cold (Water), Lightning (Air) or Fire (Fire) damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.
